gates.evidence: The complete board at left shows a broad charcoal doorway, a human-shaped dark silhouette centered in its opening, and three distinct transom panes. The real right doorway also has three separate transom panes, and its visible opening through to the floor is empty. component_findings: Drawn doorway and human silhouette: visible.
Drawn transom: three panes.
Actual transom: three panes.
Actual opening: empty and assessable.
Matching large architectural geometry: visible.

gates.name: 단서에서 실제 문간으로 향한 반응
gates.evidence: The head is turned toward frame right and the visible pupils also point right toward the actual doorway, while both hands remain on the board. Slightly drawn brows and the parted mouth read as concentrated questioning rather than an unrelated camera pose. The picture supports a directed check; it does not establish the student’s hidden thoughts or the drawing’s history.
component_findings: Head and eye direction connect to real right doorway.
Board remains held during the response.

gates.name: 양손·그림판·탁자의 연결과 지지
required_visible_components: 서로 다른 그림판 양옆의 두 손 접촉
gates.evidence: Two distinct hands grip the two separate board side edges and the bottom edge visibly rests on the tabletop. The near forearm and bent elbow connect clearly to the student’s white sleeve; the far cuff/hand at the left edge is positioned at a plausible reach, with its intervening arm naturally occluded by the board. No extra hand or contradictory contact is visible. The exact hidden elbow configuration is not claimed. All consequential grip and support endpoints are visible.
component_findings: Separate side-edge grips: visible.
Bottom-edge/table support: visible.
Near arm continuity and plausible far-hand ownership: supported.

gates.evidence: Without the synopsis, the photograph reads as a student in a sunlit art classroom pausing with a drawing of a figure in a doorway while checking an empty doorway beside her. The face, charcoal silhouette, and real opening form the main hierarchy. Natural side light, a slim hair edge, restrained room colors, and used desks sustain a quiet school-drama impression. The skirt and portrait-board departures remain recorded separately and are not erased by this whole-image impression.
component_findings: Coherent ordinary school-drama photograph.
Face, drawing clue, and empty doorway form one readable question.

reason: Original required gate C01 fails because navy trousers were visibly replaced by a pleated skirt. Seven other original gates have visible support. No gate was softened after seeing candidates or pixels.

Several art materials and pinned drawings were added by the image model; they remain subordinate to the main clue rather than replacing it.
